public.text: The Product Catalogue Management Tool is described as downstream from the registry, but operational catalogues may add attributes and curate product records before the national master is established.
public.suggestedRevision: Allow bidirectional governance workflows for proposing product additions or corrections, while preserving the Product Registry as the authoritative identity reference once records are approved.
